summary: Independent implementation review approves fixed subject 0a20779ae6b3bd357c3a2ff785a9fb760f76b490 against the current frozen specification, recomputed native implementation context and canonical passed evidence digest. The cumulative source changes remain minimal: standard text-stream readlines in the task and legacy analysis readers, StringIO universal-newline reading for committed snapshots, ASCII escaping only facts result JSON, and allow_unicode=False in the existing shared YAML writer. No new parser abstraction, module, option, dependency, Schema, Policy or execution authority is introduced. Actual task and CLI paths preserve valid Unicode separators, exact decoded Chinese and emoji under ASCII, GBK and UTF-8 output, apply and preview behavior, no-op artifact bytes, event order, validation errors and private-field projection boundaries. The prior high NEL data-integrity finding is closed: independent real-writer checks on this fixed subject confirmed normal save, strict load and no-op, plus interrupted replacement, wrong-actor zero-write rejection and original-actor recovery with exact Unicode values, unchanged original event bytes and timestamp. New YAML serialization uses standard escapes; historical files and unescaped UTF-8 event writing are not rewritten, and already-corrupt historical values are not reconstructed. Companion tests exercise the actual defects, line-ending and terminal-newline compatibility, malformed and blank rejection, legacy reports, snapshots and their availability consumer while retaining failed and unknown outcomes. Fresh native V1 passed all ten required checks; its shared complete pytest run passed 3835 tests in 1074.58 seconds, core and analysis total coverage is 89 and 97 percent, and both domains have 100 percent diff coverage. Independent whitespace inspection passed and no source changes followed the verified subject. The deliberately abandoned earlier verification remains failed historical evidence. No open findings remain. Current Gate, required remote CI and merge-commit publication remain separate steps; this local review does not establish real scoring, host integration, production effectiveness or permission for the paused activities.
